title: Embedded Systems
concept: XIOM for embedded systems — bare metal programming, no_std environments, hardware registers, and microcontroller development.
why: Embedded systems are everywhere — IoT, automotive, medical, industrial. XIOM's zero-cost abstractions and memory safety make it ideal for resource-constrained devices.
tips: no_std programs have no heap by default — use static allocation or arena allocators
volatile reads/writes are essential for hardware registers — the compiler won't optimize them away
Interrupt handlers must be FAST — defer work to the main loop or a task
Test embedded code on QEMU before deploying to hardware — faster iteration cycle
common_mistakes: Using standard library features in no_std — they depend on an OS
Forgetting volatile on register access — the compiler 'optimizes away' IO
Stack overflow in embedded — your stack might be only 1KB, recursive functions are dangerous
